The Resonant Practitioner

A self-directed graduate program in movement, movement healing, and cultural influence.

This handbook is a graduate-level training manual + a personal university program + an iconic-practice playbook, all in one.

How to use this site

  • Read the 12 modules in order (1–2 weeks each). Each has reading, a practicum, and a deliverable.
  • Consult the appendices as living references — the Class Construction Toolkit, the Master Cue Library, the Pseudoscience Audit, and the Reading Map.
  • Work the Methodology Design Lab (60-page workbook) alongside Modules 8–12.
  • Read the concept summaries when you don’t have time for the full book yet.

Program at a glance

Module 0Orientation & MandatePersonal mandate, lineage map, measurable outcome contract. Module 1Lineage StudyMovement traditions and cousin lineages, with comparative matrix. Module 2Anatomy & BiomechanicsJoints, fascia, breath, gait, common injury patterns. Module 3Nervous System & TraumaInteroception, polyvagal critique, trauma-informed operations. Module 4Neuroscience of RhythmEntrainment, groove, predictive timing, hyperscanning. Module 5Music PsychologyArousal-valence, ISO principle, the Five-Channel Score. Module 6Group SynchronizationCollective effervescence, co-regulation, ritual design. Module 7Flow StatesCsikszentmihalyi, group flow, the eight design levers. Module 8Emotional Arc DesignThe Six-Phase Cathartic Arc — your original framework. Module 9Teaching MethodologyCueing, coaching psychology, behavior change. Module 10Instructional DesignBackward design, Bloom for movement, the seven essential decisions. Module 11Methodology Design LabBuild your own system and certification. Module 12Public PracticeBecoming a fitness icon: Fonda, LaLanne, Pilates, Iyengar, you. WorkbookMethodology Design Lab60-page worksheet companion to Module 11. Appendix BClass Construction ToolkitOne-page plan, default score, ten teaching drills, checklist. Appendix CMaster Cue Library200+ cues organized by intent. LibraryConcept SummariesConcise summaries of every key text cited.

Typography, color & accessibility

Atkinson Hyperlegible body type on a warm off-white (#FAF7F2) background. Clay accent (#B85C38) and sage accent (#4E6151). Body text in near-black (#1F1F1F). All combinations meet WCAG AA contrast; most meet AAA.
